interface.defaultPrompt: Show my CodeRook projects and their latest versions.
interface.longDescription: Work on private CodeRook drafts from either computer through MCP. Read, search, edit and review remote files, save complete versions without downloading whole projects, and run administrator-configured hosted or native recipes. Deployments require an authorised named target and saved content. Remote workspaces share project state and handover notes across clients; native testing requires a connected compatible runner.

name: coderook-codex
description: Read, edit, check and save private CodeRook workspaces remotely from Codex.
